verdict.rationale: The Comptroller runs eSystems/Webfile, which collects taxpayer data, so a privacy posture on AI-training use is a fair question for this kind of service. However, no evidence describes any AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or training restriction. The open-data and portal evidence covers publishing datasets and filing workflows, not preventing AI training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
